exact.太阳同步轨道的倾角都在 98° 上下——略大于 90° 的「逆行」轨道，正好让轨: Sun-synchronous orbits all sit near 98° inclination — a slightly retrograde orbit that lets the orbital plane precess eastward 0.99° per day, keeping pace with the Sun. That is why they pass over at the same local time every day.

exact.默认按 60 倍速前进。调到 3600 倍，一分钟就能看完一整天的轨道扫描；配合: Runs at 60× by default. At 3600× a full day of orbital sweep takes a minute; pair it with “Sweep one day” below to see how much of Earth a satellite covers in a day.
exact.是这颗星飞行的闭合路径。极轨卫星的轨道近乎南北走向，静止卫星的轨道退化成赤道面上: The closed path the satellite flies. Polar-orbiting satellites run almost north–south; a geostationary orbit degenerates into a single point on the equatorial plane.
exact.是卫星一次成像扫过的地面宽度。MODIS 一次扫 2330 公里，WorldVi: The ground width a satellite sweeps in one pass. MODIS covers 2,330 km at a time; WorldView-3 only 13 km — the sharper the view, the narrower it must be.
exact.把这一天的刈幅全部叠起来。极轨卫星会织出一张覆盖全球的条纹网，静止卫星始终只有同: Stack every swath from one day. Polar orbiters weave a striped net over the whole globe; a geostationary satellite keeps staring at the same disc.
exact.轨道高度做了非线性压缩：极轨层之间保留了相对高低，静止轨道被拉到 1.9 倍地球: Orbit altitudes are non-linearly compressed: relative heights within the polar layer are preserved, and the geostationary belt is pushed out to 1.9 Earth radii, otherwise it would sit off-screen. At true scale it is 6.6 Earth radii from the centre.
exact.轨道根数取自 CelesTrak 公开发布的 TLE（两行根数），由平均运动反算: Orbital elements come from publicly published CelesTrak TLEs (two-line elements); altitude and period are back-derived from mean motion, and geostationary longitudes from the epoch phase. Satellite positions are propagated in real time as circular Keplerian motion plus J2 nodal precession — not a full SGP4 perturbation model, so this is popular-science accuracy. Resolution, swath and revisit values are nominal published figures; actual imaging depends on off-nadir pointing, cloud cover and tasking. Data is fetched once at build time; the page makes no external requests at runtime. This page draws no national borders; the globe texture is a public daytime image.
